descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de resurse umane
We are looking for a Senior Offensive Security Analyst to join an international cybersecurity team focused on proactive defense, advanced penetration testing and technical validation of critical vulnerabilities. This is a hands-on senior role with the opportunity to help build and shape an Offensive Security capability from the ground up, define standards and methodologies, and support the growth of the function over time. You will work closely with Vulnerability Management, SecOps, CSIRT and Red Team stakeholders across a large, global technology environment.
 Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end penetration testing engagements across servers, networks, cloud environments and applications
Validate critical vulnerabilities through controlled exploitation, technical analysis and Proof-of-Concept development
Assess the real-world impact and exploitability of vulnerabilities identified by vulnerability management teams
Design and execute adversary emulation and Purple Team exercises aligned with MITRE ATT&CK
Work with SecOps and CSIRT teams to test and improve EDR, SIEM and SOAR detections
Perform internal infrastructure testing, including Active Directory attack paths, privilege escalation, lateral movement and network pivoting
Conduct web application and API security testing using both manual and automated techniques
Perform OSINT, reconnaissance and attack surface mapping to support threat-driven testing
Develop and maintain offensive security scripts and repeatable testing workflows using Python, Bash and/or PowerShell
Produce clear technical reports, executive summaries and actionable remediation guidance
Support incident simulations, readiness exercises and threat-hunting initiatives
Contribute to the definition of offensive security standards, processes and tooling
Mentor junior team members as the offensive security capability grows
 Profile
OSCP certification is required
Minimum 5 years of experience in penetration testing / offensive security
Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability exploitation and technical validation
Solid experience with Windows and Linux exploitation
Strong understanding of Active Directory attack techniques, including Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, delegation abuse, pass-the-hash, ACL/GPO misconfigurations and lateral movement
Experience with privilege escalation, internal network testing, pivoting and tunneling
Strong web application security knowledge, including SQLi, XSS, SSTI, IDOR, CSRF, file upload vulnerabilities
Strong familiarity with Burp Suite
Experience with common offensive tools
Good understanding of common enterprise protocols and services such as SMB, LDAP, RDP, MSSQL, DNS, SMTP and web servers
Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash or PowerShell
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and Purple Team methodologies
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong autonomy, analytical thinking and attention to detail
Experience working in international or distributed environments is highly valued
